subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw allow any recovery path that converts assistant text into executable tool calls for this vLLM `gpt-oss-120b` case, or require structured tool-call deltas plus an explicit safe terminal signal first?
rationale: The reported failure blocks real tool execution, but the suggested text-block recovery could execute model-visible text as tools unless maintainers approve a narrow trust boundary.

options.title: Require structured terminal proof
options.body: Keep the default fail-closed boundary and accept only fixes that prove structured `delta.tool_calls` plus a safe terminal signal for the affected stream shape.

options.title: Treat no-finish work as canonical
options.body: If maintainers decide the exact failure is actually the no-`finish_reason` class, route this issue behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98124 and close only after that path lands and proves vLLM behavior.

options.title: Approve narrow text recovery
options.body: Permit a provider/model-gated text-to-tool recovery only with live vLLM proof, security review, and regression tests preventing arbitrary assistant text execution.

recommendation.title: Require structured terminal proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default fail-closed boundary and accept only fixes that prove structured `delta.tool_calls` plus a safe terminal signal for the affected stream shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Ted Li authored the current stop-finished promotion and fail-closed terminal behavior that defines the safety boundary under review.
